name: Sennan (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sennan city emblem in navy: a ring with pointed ends crossed by horizontal bars, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Sennan, a city in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 April 1958.

features.role: Sennan city emblem — a ring with pointed ends crossed by horizontal bars, like a stylised character
